title: E-Rate approved invoices and net disbursements
question: Do the two public totals reconcile for the same funding year, request number and billed entity?
finding: Of 711 comparable funding requests, 697 matched to the cent and 14 differed. At San Francisco Unified, 311 of 315 matched. The largest difference came from FY2021 request 2199036752.
how: Group the 4,399 invoice lines in the San Francisco billed-entity extract by funding request and entity. Preserve negative amounts and exclude header totals repeated on different lines. Join the current application once and require a reported net disbursement and matching invoice lines.
limits: These are public reporting measures. Later recoveries, timing and adjustments can affect the net amount. The comparison excludes requests missing either measure and does not establish what changed hands. The issuer’s data links show the latest revisions.
